name: tableau-next-app-templates
description: Package a Tableau Next analytics app as an installable App Template Framework (ATF) template that ships its own CSV data. On Create it builds the whole stack bottom-up in any org — CSV to Data Stream to Data Lake Object to Semantic Model to visualizations to dashboard — with no pre-existing assets and no hardcoded org-specific names. Bundles the CSV_Example and superstore_demo_template reference implementations and the Superstore case study.
